reason: Replaced the legacy Nigeria VAT page contract with one Nigeria Tax Act 2025 implementation. The shared engine preserved the 7.5% standard calculation, introduced distinct exempt and zero-rated paths, labelled custom rates as planning scenarios, and powered the English, French, Swahili and widget surfaces. The statutory section labels in that first implementation were subsequently corrected by the 2026-08-02 source review, so this earlier record does not support the current section mapping.
